### eventbridge-some-errors-skip-retries

**Claim.** Some EventBridge events are dropped or sent to a DLQ without any retry attempts. EventBridge sends these events directly to the target DLQ, if you have specified one.

**Write it as.** `without any retry attempts` · `sends these events directly to the target DLQ`

**Scope.** EventBridge rule target; until action is taken to resolve the underlying issue.

EventBridge sends these events directly to the target DLQ, if you have specified one."
> — [Using dead-letter queues to process undelivered events in EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-rule-dlq.html)
